professions.name: Foundry Smithing & Bell-Metallurgy
professions.description: Forge pale-iron weapons, bell-bronze warhammers, resonant shields, and slag-plate armor.

professions.name: Brasswork & Clockwork Artifice
professions.description: Assemble mechanical repeaters, crossbows, prismatic lanterns, resonant chimes, and brass chronometers.

professions.name: Oilskin & Salt-Leathercraft
professions.description: Stitch weather-warded oilskin coats, stealth cloaks, brigandines, sinew bows, and frontier boots.

professions.name: Mnemonic Alchemy & Runic Sealcraft
professions.description: Distill healing salves, furnace tonics, and memory elixirs, and inscribe mnemonic rings, staves, circlets, and focus prisms.
